documents.title: Primary care: new diagnosis of type 2 diabetes
documents.text: 47-year-old man with fatigue and increased thirst. HbA1c 9.1%. Diagnosis: type 2 diabetes. Blood pressure 148/92, started on lisinopril. Family history: mother with type 2 diabetes. Started metformin.

documents.title: Lipid panel and HbA1c
documents.text: LDL cholesterol 142 mg/dL. HbA1c 8.0%. Statin started.

documents.title: Primary care: diabetes follow-up
documents.text: Adherence to metformin inconsistent. Diet counseling provided. Weight 104 kg. Foot exam normal at this visit.

documents.title: Primary care: foot numbness
documents.text: Numbness and tingling in both feet for one year, in a stocking distribution. Reduced ankle reflexes and reduced monofilament sensation bilaterally. HbA1c 8.4%. Vitamin B12 normal. Impression: diabetic peripheral neuropathy.

documents.title: Gastroenterology: heartburn
documents.text: Heartburn after meals and when lying down for two years. Upper endoscopy shows mild erosive esophagitis. No diarrhea or weight loss. Impression: gastroesophageal reflux disease. Started proton pump inhibitor.

documents.title: Cardiology: exertional chest tightness
documents.text: Chest tightness climbing stairs. Stress test shows no ischemia. Echocardiogram shows mild left ventricular hypertrophy consistent with long-standing hypertension. Continue current medications.

documents.title: Ophthalmology: diabetic eye exam
documents.text: Dilated exam shows moderate nonproliferative diabetic retinopathy in both eyes. Corneas clear. No macular edema. Repeat exam in six months.

documents.title: Nephrology consult: albuminuria
documents.text: Referred for albuminuria. Urine albumin-to-creatinine ratio 180 mg/g. eGFR 64. Long-standing type 2 diabetes and hypertension, with diabetic retinopathy on recent eye exam. Impression: diabetic kidney disease. Biopsy not indicated.

documents.title: Primary care: annual visit
documents.text: HbA1c 7.6%. Neuropathy symptoms stable. Reflux controlled on proton pump inhibitor. Blood pressure 134/84. Started SGLT2 inhibitor for kidney protection.

documents.title: Podiatry: foot care
documents.text: Loss of protective sensation in both feet on monofilament testing. Callus on right first metatarsal head, debrided. No ulcer. Diabetic footwear recommended.
